prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic tropical fashion editorial with natural skin texture, cinematic composition, and no added text or logos.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with dark hair in a sleek low bun, seated elegantly on a short wooden dock. She wears a vibrant red sleeveless mini dress with thin straps and a softly flared hem, lightweight fabric with natural folds and realistic drape, plus minimal accessories.
prompt.composition_elements: Her body faces toward the pond with her back and right shoulder visible in a three-quarter view; head turned slightly left, calm reflective posture. The dock extends over dark still water covered with large circular green lily pads, framed by two rope-wrapped posts. Tropical greenery, palms, and small wooden structures sit behind her. Use a 3:4 portrait crop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural daylight under clear blue sky, tropical natural green and warm red balance, crisp but natural detail, subtle 35mm grain, reflective and tasteful editorial mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 portrait orientation, cinematic photoreal editorial rendering, natural-not-HDR dynamic range, realistic skin texture, subtle film grain, sharp but natural focus, no readable text, no watermark.
